about: Perranporth Surf School has taught on Perranporth Beach in Cornwall since 2004 and calls itself the longest-established surf school in the village. In summer it works from a base on the beach, and in winter from Piran Surf. It teaches all abilities from age seven, from a first lesson up to week-long courses.
offers: Introductory lessons through to full-week improver courses
where: Perranporth Beach (summer base on the beach; winter base at Piran Surf); main promenade car park overlooks the base
goodToKnow: All equipment is included, with two hours of surfing time per lesson
Showers and toilets within 100 m; secure storage boxes for belongings
Book online, by phone or by email; book 24 hours ahead in summer
Instructors described as Surfing England qualified
season: Summer on the beach and winter from Piran Surf (no months given)
gaps: No cancellation terms or what-to-bring list.
